proposition: Melvin-Koushki's 2019 article on the Munāẓara-yi Bazm u Razm states, more strongly than the dissertation's plain "written for" (CL-0237), that it was written at Bāysunghur's request -- grouping it as the fourth of four treatises MK reads as written at a named Timurid patron's request or instance (Suʾl al-Mulūk for Shāhrukh at Bāysunghur's instance; Sharḥ al-Basmala for Ulugh Beg; the Bazm u Razm itself, for and now also at the request of, Bāysunghur).

mediation.note: MK's own synthesis, not a document quoted from the work itself; no citation is given on this page for the request beyond MK's own claim, so this is uncited testimony from the same scholar rather than independently corroborated -- rated no lower than CL-0237's cited claim.
